preview_median_d_centre_deg.Description: Median across the participant's preview trials of the distance of gaze at search-display onset from the screen centre. Gaze position at search-display onset is the mean position of the fixation in progress at onset (at least 40 ms long, beginning within 100 ms of onset); trials without one are dropped. Converted at 51.383 pixels per degree.

Gaze position at search-display onset is the mean position of the fixation in progress at onset (at least 40 ms long, beginning within 100 ms of onset); trials without one are dropped. Converted at 51.383 pixels per degree.
